description: This Java class 'InventoryReservationFlow' is a service component responsible for managing inventory reservation and release operations within an e-commerce inventory system. It provides methods to reserve stock quantities, release reserved stock, and retrieve current stock status for specific store and SKU combinations. The class enforces validation, handles exceptions related to stock availability, and interacts with a repository for persistent storage.

classes.name: InventoryReservationFlow
classes.description: A service class for handling inventory reservation and release flows, with methods to reserve stock, release reserved stock, and retrieve current stock information.

classes.name: BaseMutationRequest
classes.description: A sealed interface representing common request parameters for inventory mutation operations, with implementations for reservation and release requests.

classes.name: ReserveRequest
classes.description: A record implementing 'BaseMutationRequest' for reserve operations, encapsulating store ID, SKU, and quantity.

classes.name: ReleaseRequest
classes.description: A record implementing 'BaseMutationRequest' for release operations, encapsulating store ID, SKU, and quantity.

methods.name: reserve
methods.description: Reserves a specified quantity of stock for a given store and SKU, increasing the reserved count in the inventory. Throws exceptions if stock is insufficient or if the stock record is not found.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases a specified quantity of reserved stock for a given store and SKU, decreasing the reserved count, with validation to prevent releasing more than reserved.

methods.name: getStock
methods.description: Retrieves the current inventory stock snapshot for a specific store and SKU, with input validation.

methods.name: validateRequest
methods.description: A private static method that validates the incoming mutation request, ensuring all required fields are present and valid.
